tools.name: search_disclosure_awards
tools.description: Search the NYC Council's expense funding disclosure — the Council's own award-level list of discretionary expense designations, FY2009 and FY2011–FY2027 (FY2010 is NOT included: the Council's archived workbook for it is incomplete against NYC Open Data, so it is left out). One row per published row (exact copies are kept and flagged), with clearance status, funding stream, agency and the grantee's mailing address; MOCS ID from FY2024, and for FY2009–FY2021 the MOCS ID NYC Open Data gives the same designation (od_mocs_id) where the pairing is unambiguous. FY2009 and FY2013 are EARLY SNAPSHOTS: frozen while much was Pending and never revised, so their Cleared totals are not headline figures; the answer says so. This is a later snapshot than the adopted budget: it includes designations made after adoption, and council_member is the roster when the workbook was exported. Every row is returned whatever its status unless you filter on status; the response gives the TRUE number of matching rows and totals over all of them (Cleared and Pending separately), even when the rows shown are limited, plus the file, sheet, source and retrieval date of each year. Filter by any combination of fiscal_year, ein, legal_name, council_member (substring) or council_member_id (exact Legistar person ID — 'Levin' and 'Levine' are different people), source (substring) or source_exact, agency, program_name, zip (exact 5-digit), zip_status, city (exact), status, mocs_id, od_mocs_id, min_amount, max_amount. Rows come highest amount first. Purpose text is not served; each row gives its workbook row number in the source repo. Text filters match case- and accent-insensitive substrings, except that a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words ('AI' does not match 'Jamaica'); whole_word overrides that for the call, and the answer says when it applied. Identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings.

fiscal_year.description: FY2009 or FY2011–FY2027. FY2010 is not in the dataset; asking for it returns the reason.

ein.description: Grantee tax ID: exactly 9 digits, hyphens optional (anything else is an error, never padded). Matches the grantee EIN only, not the fiscal conduit's. One EIN can cover many bodies (136400434 is the City of New York); the answer says how many legal names it matched.

legal_name.description: Grantee legal name (substring, case-insensitive; % and _ are literal)

council_member.description: Council member as the workbook names them (case-insensitive substring; 'Levin' also matches 'Levine', and the answer lists every value matched with its Legistar person ID) — the roster at export time, e.g. 'Speaker' for Speaker's designations. For one person, use council_member_id.

council_member_id.description: Exact Legistar person ID of the council member (e.g. '7567' Stephen T. Levin, '7634' Mark Levine), as resolved per fiscal year by the repo's member crosswalk from the Council MCP's Legistar index. Rows whose printed name is ambiguous, unresolved, a delegation, 'Speaker' or blank carry no ID and never match. Digits only.

source.description: Funding stream as the workbook names it (case-insensitive substring; 'Youth' also matches initiatives such as 'Summer Youth Employment Program', and the answer lists every value matched): Local, Youth, Aging, Speaker's Initiative, or a citywide initiative name. For one stream exactly, use source_exact.

source_exact.description: Funding stream, exact: equal to the workbook's value ignoring case and surrounding whitespace ('Youth' matches the Youth stream only).

zip.description: Grantee mailing ZIP, exactly 5 digits (anything else is an error). Matches the 5-digit zip derived from the published postal_code (ZIP+4 read to its first five; a 4-digit ZIP padded, a ragged ZIP+4 trimmed, or a 6-digit ZIP repaired, only into a 2020 ZCTA of the row's own state). Rows whose zip_status is ambiguous_extra_digit, invalid or blank have no zip and never match. A mailing address, not where services were delivered.

zip_status.description: How the zip was read, checked against the Census 2020 ZCTAs: valid, padded (leading zero restored), trimmed (ragged ZIP+4 such as '11203-', '11231=1020' or '11413 ZipCode2: 3929'), repaired_extra_digit (6 digits printed; exactly one one-digit deletion is an in-state ZCTA, e.g. '111691' -> 11691), ambiguous_extra_digit (6 digits; two or more deletions are, e.g. '114345' -> 11434 or 11435; no zip, candidates shown on the row), not_a_zcta (not verified, not fake: PO-box ZIPs have no ZCTA), state_mismatch, invalid (no ZIP readable), blank (none printed).

city.description: Grantee mailing city, exact match ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, as printed: 'brooklyn' matches 'Brooklyn' and 'BROOKLYN', but not the cells printed 'Brooklyn,' or 'Brooklyn NY', and 'Bronx' does not match 'The Bronx'; 'New York' is how most Manhattan rows print. Not a borough or district filter.

status.description: Restrict to one clearance status. Omit for all (the default; totals are still reported per status).

mocs_id.description: The workbook's own MOCS ID, exact (case and surrounding whitespace ignored), e.g. 'FY26 01234'. Printed from FY2024 only.

od_mocs_id.description: NYC Open Data 4d7f-74pe's MOCS ID for the same designation, exact (case and surrounding whitespace ignored), e.g. 'FY09 2838'. FY2009–FY2021 only, and only where the pairing is unambiguous. A cross-reference, not a source.

whole_word.description: How this call's text filters match. Omit it for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits (after trimming) matches whole words, a longer term matches anywhere, as a substring. true: every name and prose filter matches whole words only, the term not inside a longer word ('AI' finds 'AI Training Program', '(AI)', 'AI-powered', 'BetaNYC's AI', but not 'Jamaica' or 'AIDS'). false: every name and prose filter matches substrings. Pass false to find a short term inside words (e.g. 'AI' inside 'AIDS'); pass true to keep a longer word from matching longer ones ('Fellow' but not 'Fellowship'). Case, accents and punctuation folding are the same either way, and % and _ stay literal. It applies to name and prose filters only: identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings, so an ID fragment such as 'CC1' or '101' finds the IDs that contain it, and exact filters (EIN, IDs, budget line, codes, city, zip) are not affected. The answer says which filters matched as whole words.

limit.description: Max rows shown, 1–500 (default 50; above 500 is capped at 500, below 1 is an error). Totals always cover every match.

tools.name: search_council_capital
tools.description: Search the NYC Council's capital designations (Council-funded capital projects), FY2015–FY2017 and FY2019–FY2027 (FY2018 is missing from every source found). FY2015–FY2017, FY2026 and FY2027 come from the Council's own capital workbooks, FY2019–FY2025 from NYC Open Data t474-a92g, which the Council publishes; each answer names the file, retrieval date and sha256 of every year it draws on. One row per (record, fiscal-year amount): a list's own-year amount and any out-year amounts are separate rows, totaled separately. Filter by any combination of fiscal_year (the list's year), amount_fy, budget_line (exact, e.g. 'P D018'), project_id (exact), sponsor (substring) or sponsor_exact, borough (exact code), council_district (workbook years only), title and description (substrings), min_amount, max_amount. Answers give the TRUE match count and totals over every match, highest amount first. Exact by budget line only: the Council's project IDs are internal and do not link to OMB, FMS or Checkbook projects, and there is no contract-level data. sponsor carries no Legistar ID. Text filters match case- and accent-insensitive substrings, except that a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words ('AI' does not match 'Jamaica'); whole_word overrides that for the call, and the answer says when it applied. Identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings.

fiscal_year.description: The Council capital list's fiscal year (report year): FY2015–FY2017 or FY2019–FY2027. FY2018 returns why it is missing.

amount_fy.description: The fiscal year an amount is for: the list's own year or an out-year (e.g. fiscal_year 2027 with amount_fy 2028 gives FY2027's out-year amounts).

budget_line.description: Budget line, exact, as agency code then line, separated by a space or '-' ('P D018', 'PW-DN846', 'hl dn164'). A value without the separator ('PD018') is refused, because where the agency code ends cannot be told. The only key shared with OMB's capital datasets. FY2016 prints no budget lines.

project_id.description: The Council's project ID, exact, ignoring case and runs of spaces ('E  CN459' = 'e cn459'). Unique within one year only; not an FMS or Checkbook ID. FY2015 prints none.

sponsor.description: Sponsor as printed (case-insensitive substring; % and _ literal): a member's surname, 'Speaker', a delegation or caucus, 'Technical Adjustments'. The answer lists every value matched. No Legistar ID is attached.

sponsor_exact.description: Sponsor, exact, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace ('Rivera' matches 'Rivera' only, not 'De La Rosa-Rivera').

borough.description: Borough code exactly as printed (case-sensitive): K Brooklyn, M Manhattan, Q Queens, R Staten Island, X Bronx, C citywide. 'A' (meaning unconfirmed) and FY2016's lower-case 'k' and 'x' are kept as printed and are matched only by those exact values.

council_district.description: One council district or code, 0–99 (0 Speaker, 88–98 caucuses and delegations, 99 Technical Adjustments): matches a row whose printed district list contains it. Council-workbook years only (FY2015–FY2017, FY2026, FY2027): t474 years never match, because Open Data collapsed their district lists into single numbers.

title.description: Project title (substring, case-insensitive; % and _ literal). In many FY2019 rows the title names the organization.

whole_word.description: How this call's text filters match. Omit it for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits (after trimming) matches whole words, a longer term matches anywhere, as a substring. true: every name and prose filter matches whole words only, the term not inside a longer word ('AI' finds 'AI Training Program', '(AI)', 'AI-powered', 'BetaNYC's AI', but not 'Jamaica' or 'AIDS'). false: every name and prose filter matches substrings. Pass false to find a short term inside words (e.g. 'AI' inside 'AIDS'); pass true to keep a longer word from matching longer ones ('Fellow' but not 'Fellowship'). Case, accents and punctuation folding are the same either way, and % and _ stay literal. It applies to name and prose filters only: identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings, so an ID fragment such as 'CC1' or '101' finds the IDs that contain it, and exact filters (EIN, IDs, budget line, codes, city, zip) are not affected. The answer says which filters matched as whole words.

limit.description: Max rows shown, 1–500 (default 50; above 500 is capped at 500, below 1 is an error). Totals always cover every match.

tools.name: compare_capital_to_omb
tools.description: Compare the Council capital list with OMB's adopted Capital Budget (NYC Open Data 46m8-77gv), by budget line, FY2019–FY2027: for each report year and Council-series budget line, the Council's total and OMB's adopted total for that year and the next, and a verdict (match, differ, council_only, omb_only). This is BetaNYC's arithmetic, not a Council or OMB reconciliation; 'match' is about the line's totals, not its projects. Filter by report_year, budget_line (exact) and verdict. Lines that disagree come first.

budget_line.description: Budget line, exact, as agency code then line ('P D018')

verdict.description: match (both years equal to the dollar), differ, council_only (no OMB line), omb_only (no Council row)

limit.description: Max lines shown, 1–500 (default 50). Counts always cover every match.

tools.name: search_schedule_c_awards
tools.description: Search the adopted budget's Schedule C (the Council's discretionary awards as printed in the budget PDF: the body and appendices A, B and C), FY2018–FY2027, from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the PDFs. Every row is labeled "checked, review in progress" or "checked and reviewed", with its flags, review decision and note where decided, three links (the row highlighted on its page in the explorer, the PDF on GitHub at the build's commit, the publisher's copy where known), and disclosure_status: whether the same EIN and amount is in the Council's disclosure spreadsheet (search_disclosure_awards, a separate tool and a later snapshot) as cleared or pending, or unmatched with the reason. Values are as printed. Sub-awards printed under an award (the Jobs to Build On partner list, FY2018 and FY2019) are listed under it and never counted. Filter by any combination of fiscal_year, organization, ein, member (member or sponsor), category, initiative, agency, purpose, disclosure_status, min_amount, max_amount; the answer gives the TRUE match count and totals over every match, highest amount first. Needs the optional PDF tables download; without it the answer says how to add it. Text filters match case- and accent-insensitive substrings, except that a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words ('AI' does not match 'Jamaica'); whole_word overrides that for the call, and the answer says when it applied. Identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings.

fiscal_year.description: FY2018–FY2027. Earlier years were read only by the old parser and are not served.

organization.description: Organization as printed (case- and accent-insensitive substring; % and _ literal)

ein.description: EIN, exactly 9 digits, hyphens optional. Matches the organization's EIN or its fiscal conduit's (the group that receives the money for it), as the explorer does

member.description: Council member, sponsor or delegation as printed (substring), e.g. 'Brewer', 'Speaker', 'Queens Delegation'

disclosure_status.description: cleared or pending: paired with a row of that status in the disclosure spreadsheet by EIN and amount; unmatched: not found there

The answer says which filters matched as whole words.

tools.name: search_transparency_changes
tools.description: Search the Council's transparency resolutions, FY2018–FY2026: the changes made to the adopted budget's designations after adoption (new designations, rescissions, purpose-of-funds changes), from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the resolution PDFs. Each row gives the resolution number and date, the chart, the budget year it changes, the organization, EIN, member, agency and amount as printed, with its status label ("checked, review in progress" or "checked and reviewed"), flags, review decision where decided, any hidden text (text in the PDF a reader cannot see on the page, always labeled), and its three links. Rows from charts that print no dollar amount are kept and never summed. Filter by fiscal_year (the resolutions' year), budget_fiscal_year, organization, ein, member, resolution_number (substring, e.g. '1013-2025'), resolution_date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a date_from / date_to range, action. Newest resolution first. Totals per kind of change cover every match. Needs the optional PDF tables download. Text filters match case- and accent-insensitive substrings, except that a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words ('AI' does not match 'Jamaica'); whole_word overrides that for the call, and the answer says when it applied. Identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year whose resolutions to search, FY2018–FY2026

budget_fiscal_year.description: The budget year a row's chart changes (a year's resolutions can change another year's budget)

ein.description: EIN, exactly 9 digits, hyphens optional. Matches the organization's EIN or its fiscal conduit's

resolution_number.description: Resolution number (substring, always: an identifier, so whole_word and the short-term rule do not apply; '101' finds '1013-2025'), e.g. 'Res 1013-2025' or '1013-2025'

date_from.description: Resolutions dated on or after, YYYY-MM-DD

date_to.description: Resolutions dated on or before, YYYY-MM-DD

action.description: designate, rescind, purpose_from / purpose_to (a purpose-of-funds change), listed (a chart with no dollar amount)

whole_word.description: How this call's text filters match. Omit it for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits (after trimming) matches whole words, a longer term matches anywhere, as a substring. true: every name and prose filter matches whole words only, the term not inside a longer word ('AI' finds 'AI Training Program', '(AI)', 'AI-powered', 'BetaNYC's AI', but not 'Jamaica' or 'AIDS'). false: every name and prose filter matches substrings. tools.name: search_capital_book
tools.description: Search the capital budget's §254 supporting detail (the "capital book": OMB's list of the Council's changes to the executive capital budget, Parts I and II), FY2018–FY2020 and FY2022–FY2027, from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the PDFs. Each project row gives its ID, budget line, borough, agency, title, sponsor and the four printed year amounts as printed, with its status label, flags, review decision where decided, and three links. Filter by fiscal_year, project_id (substring: 'CC0001' finds 'HO CC0001'), budget_line (exact, e.g. 'P D018'), sponsor, borough (code), agency, title (also searches FY2019's descriptions), part, min_amount / max_amount (the book's own year). Rows in book order. The total is Part I's (it ties to the book's printed total), with "of which … went to non-city groups" from Part II; rows printed only in Part II are listed apart and never added. Reductions (negative amounts) are counted on their own. A sponsor printed "CD nn" is a district with no member. For the Council's own capital lists, use search_council_capital. Needs the optional PDF tables download. Text filters match case- and accent-insensitive substrings, except that a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words ('AI' does not match 'Jamaica'); whole_word overrides that for the call, and the answer says when it applied. Identifier filters (project_id, resolution_number) always match substrings.

fiscal_year.description: The book's fiscal year: FY2018–FY2020 or FY2022–FY2027 (FY2021 is not checked yet)

project_id.description: Project ID as the book prints it (substring, case-insensitive, always: an identifier, so whole_word and the short-term rule do not apply; 'CC1' finds 'AG CC1053'): 'HO CC0001', or 'CC0001' without the agency code

budget_line.description: Budget line, exact, agency code then line ('P D018', 'PW-DN846')

sponsor.description: Sponsor as printed (substring), e.g. 'Speaker', 'Avilés'. 'CD 22' is a district with no member

borough.description: Borough code as printed, any case: K, M, Q, R, X; 'A' and 'C' also match the rows that print them (not boroughs, meaning unclear; issue #227)

part.description: The book's part: I, the projects (the total), or II, the non-city groups' list

min_amount.description: Minimum amount in the book's own year column, dollars (inclusive; reductions are negative)

max_amount.description: Maximum amount in the book's own year column, dollars (inclusive)

tools.name: search_terms_conditions

Filter by fiscal_year, agency (name or code, substring), unit (a unit of appropriation as printed, e.g. '001', or the start of a budget line), text (substring of the condition or its heading). agency.description: Agency name or code (substring), e.g. 'Correction' or '072'

unit.description: Unit of appropriation as printed ('001', 'All'), or the start of a budget line ('HD-0009')

text.description: Words in the condition's text or heading (substring)

tools.name: list_available_fiscal_years
tools.description: Report, for every fiscal year, which structured datasets this server holds and where each came from: the expense funding disclosure (loaded or not, Council RnD download or Internet Archive capture, retrieval date, early-snapshot flag), the Council capital list (Council workbook or NYC Open Data t474-a92g), and whether the year is in the Council-vs-OMB comparison. Also reports each family-year of the checked PDF tables (Schedule C, transparency resolutions, the capital book, Terms and Conditions) with its status, and whether the optional PDF tables download is installed. States the gaps plainly: FY2010 disclosure not loaded, FY2018 capital missing, nothing before FY2009, no PDF table before FY2018.
